verse.verse_1: We sent Noah to his nation, saying: 'Give warning to your nation before a painful punishment overtakes them'
verse.verse_2: He said: 'My nation, I am a clear warner for you.
verse.verse_3: Worship Allah, fear Him, and obey me.
verse.verse_4: He will forgive you your sins and respite you till an appointed term. When the term of Allah arrives it cannot be deferred; if you but knew'
verse.verse_5: 'My Lord' said he, 'night and day I have called my nation,
verse.verse_6: but my call has only increased them in running away.
verse.verse_7: Each time I called them so that You might forgive them, they thrust their fingers in their ears and wrapped themselves in their garments, and persisted becomingvery proud.
verse.verse_9: and indeed, I spoke to them both publicly and in secret:
verse.verse_10: "Ask for forgiveness of your Lord," I said. "Surely, He is the Forgiver.
verse.verse_11: He will let loose the sky upon you in abundance
verse.verse_12: and give to you wealth and sons, and provide you with gardens and rivers.
verse.verse_13: What is the matter with you that you do not want the Greatness of Allah,
verse.verse_14: He has created you by stages!
verse.verse_15: Have you not seen how Allah created the seven heavens one above the other,
verse.verse_16: setting in them the moon as a light and the sun as a lantern?
verse.verse_17: Allah has caused you to grow out of the earth,
verse.verse_18: and to it He will return you. Then, He will bring you forth.
verse.verse_19: Allah has made the earth spread out for you
verse.verse_20: so that you walk in its spacious paths.'
verse.verse_21: Noah said: 'My Lord, they have rebelled against me and followed he whose wealth and offspring increase him only in loss,
verse.verse_22: they have devised a mighty plot,
verse.verse_23: and said: 'Do not renounce your gods, do not leave waddan or suwa'an or yaghutha, or ya'uqa, or nasra'
verse.verse_24: And they have led many astray. (Noah supplicated saying): 'Allah, do not increase the harmdoers except in error'
verse.verse_25: So because of their sins they were drowned and admitted into the Fire. They found none to help them other than Allah.
verse.verse_26: And Noah (supplicated) saying: 'My Lord, do not leave a single unbeliever upon the earth.
verse.verse_27: Surely, if You leave them they will mislead Your worshipers and father none but the immoral, and unbelievers.
verse.verse_28: Forgive me, My Lord, and my parents, and whosoever seeks refuge in my house as a believer, and the believers men and women alike, and do not increase the harmdoers except in ruin'
